tools.name: btc_price
tools.description: Current Bitcoin price in major fiat currencies from mempool.space, plus sats per currency unit. Indicative, refreshed about every minute.

tools.name: mempool_fees
tools.description: Recommended Bitcoin on-chain fee rates in sat/vB (next block, ~30 min, ~1 h, economy, minimum), mempool size, current block height, and the example cost in sats of a typical 140 vB transaction.

tools.name: crypto_address_validate
tools.description: Check a cryptocurrency address offline before using it: Bitcoin legacy/P2SH (base58check), segwit/taproot (bech32/bech32m), Ethereum and all EVM chains incl. Base (EIP-55 checksum via keccak-256), Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron and Solana. Returns valid, chain, network, type, and the correctly checksummed

tools.name: lightning_address_check
tools.description: Resolve a Lightning address (user@domain) or bech32 LNURL to its LNURL-pay endpoint and return whether it is valid, min/max sendable sats, comment length, Nostr zap support and description. Never requests an invoice or pays. Also recognizes BOLT11 invoices.

tools.name: iban_validate
tools.description: Validate an International Bank Account Number: format, per-country length (80+ countries) and the ISO 7064 mod-97 checksum. Returns country, check digits, BBAN and the formatted IBAN. Format only; does not confirm the account exists.

tools.name: bic_validate
tools.description: Validate a BIC/SWIFT code's structure (bank code, ISO country, location, optional branch) and flag test BICs. Format check only, not a directory lookup.

tools.name: us_zip_lookup
tools.description: Look up a US ZIP code: city/place names, state, latitude/longitude and the state's primary IANA time zone. Useful for checkout/address sanity checks and shipping estimates.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "crypto_address_validate" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Check a cryptocurrency address offline before using it: Bitcoin legacy/P2SH (base58check), segwit/taproot (bech32/bech32m), Ethereum and all EVM chains incl. Ba…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
